$comment: Tormented Demons (docs/tormented-demons.md). zones: how many demons a player may fight at once around each tile (varbit td_multiway_indicator); a tile takes the limit of the nearest zone point. The room points are the Wiki's multicombat map of the Ancient Guthixian Temple (Map:Multicombat_AGT), whose 26 spawns fall 8/1/1 single, 5x2 double and 2x3 triple; the corridor points are where rsprox captures show the indicator, and with them every captured tile gets its captured value but the two where it changes.
